MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, as supplied. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; risk and cycle signals are N/A, so the data does not support a stronger directional call. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors; Technology 3/5 in the Top 5), neither narrow by the two-sector test nor broad across four sectors.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary was the least weak sector on the week (-1.74%); TJX is in RECOVERY (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%). Communication (-1.85%) and Industrials (-2.35%) followed, though no Communication constituent return was provided; HON is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +0.69%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy was weakest (-7.21% on the week; -14.57% on the month), with MPC BELOW TREND (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -21.55%) and VLO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -21.44%). Healthcare (-4.29%) and Financials (-4.60%) also lagged; UNH is BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) and JPM is BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -4.50%).

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%), and TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%). Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors; Technology 3/5), with no broad four-sector spread.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -12.25%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -14.79%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -10.26% | 1M: -10.86%), DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -12.30%), and MPC BELOW TREND (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -21.55%). Weakness spans Technology, Healthcare, Materials, and Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly moves were PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%), and TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%). The four RECOVERY setups diverge from their monthly declines; treat as tactical rebounds and watch for trend confirmation.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weakest sector on both reported periods: -3.52% for the week and -12.94% for the month. PANW is in RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), NVDA is in RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%), while MSFT is BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.92%) and AMD is BELOW TREND (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -12.25%); sector breadth is negative.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 4.60% on the week and 2.18% on the month. JPM is BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -4.50%); V is in CORRECTION (1W: -4.00% | 1M: +0.55%) and MA is in CORRECTION (1W: -3.96% | 1M: +1.91%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed internally but weak overall: the sector fell 4.29% on the week and 1.63% on the month. GILD is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%) and SYK is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +2.93%), while UNH is BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) and CVS is BELOW TREND (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -14.79%).

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selectivity and risk discipline rather than a strong style tilt: breadth is 0/11 and leadership is mixed, with no confirmed Growth or Value leadership. Monitor rebounds in PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%) and NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%); reduce exposure to persistent weakness such as AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -12.25%).

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%) and NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) for follow-through after sharp weekly rebounds; TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) retains a positive two-period setup.
BEARISH: Watch for continued weakness in UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) and INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -20.29% | 1M: -19.78%); confirmation of stabilization is absent in the supplied returns.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor Consumer Discretionary (-1.74% weekly) and Communication (-1.85%) for stabilization; both remain negative on the week, so momentum confirmation is needed.
BEARISH: Energy (-7.21% weekly; -14.57% monthly) and Technology (-3.52%; -12.94%) remain weakest. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so specific support or resistance prices cannot be stated. Watch whether NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) and INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%) sustain their weekly gains, and whether UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) stabilizes.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+55): China jet order headline; price diverges, with BA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -13.78%). TSLA (+45): analyst initiation and price target; sentiment confirms the positive setup, with TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.51% | 1M: +3.56%); INTC (+45): reported supply-demand strength, but the price remains in RECOVERY (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%), so follow-through is unconfirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-55): Medicare Advantage policy concern; sentiment confirms weakness, with UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%). INTU (-50): HSBC downgrade; sentiment confirms weakness, with INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -20.29% | 1M: -19.78%); CRM (-40): reduced target, with CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -13.67% | 1M: -25.39%), also confirming weakness.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL is the supplied regime; breadth is 0/11 sectors positive, leadership is mixed across three sectors, and no Growth-versus-Value style call is confirmed. GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%) and TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) show relative strength. Monitor whether positive news for BA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -13.78%) can reverse its price divergence, alongside broad sector weakness.
